howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose the engine
howto.text: On our server (the default) runs Tesseract on the PrivaTools server. My own AI key sends the image straight to a vision model at the provider you choose. In this browser runs tesseract.js on your device and downloads the language data when it is first needed.

howto.name: Select OCR language
howto.text: Pick one of 13 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi and Russian. A vision model detects the language itself, so the picker is hidden for that engine.

howto.name: Copy or download the text
howto.text: The recognized text appears in a box you can copy from, or save as a .txt file.

faq.a: Tesseract handles clean printed text well. Handwriting, low-resolution, or low-contrast images are harder.

faq.q: Should I preprocess the image first?
faq.a: Deskew helps a lot for tilted scans. Convert to grayscale doesn't help (Tesseract converts internally).
Tesseract is trained on print. Use a specialized handwriting OCR for cursive.
